environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB with TCP passthrough on port 443. The ELB performs TLS termination but has no application-layer inspection. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application runs as a systemd service under a dedicated user. No additional middleware or proxy between ELB and application. SQLite database file is owned by the app user with mode 0600.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP listener port 443 -> instance port 8080
